nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh! I remember! They're going to the toy `charity warehouse` on Industrial. Building `C!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh! I remember! They're going to the toy [color=#3b78e2][i]charity warehouse[/i][/color] on Industrial. Building [color=#3b78e2][i]C![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: ...And I think they're up to something very indecent!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Anyway, Owen, you don't have to do anything. Just wait in the car and be ready to drive in case something goes wrong.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: If we're not back in five minutes, we're in trouble, and we need your help. Come get us.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? You didn't say anything about leaving the car!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Well, I'm saying it now... Or, if you want we can drive back to Grandma's place.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, let's just get this over with.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: That's what I thought.
Sal, Dom, and Big Jon step out of the car, leaving Owen to sit while it idles...
Owen watches as they pick the lock to the chain slung through the handle of the big, glass door. A moment later, and they're in.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I could just leave them... I could just drive off and have nothing to do with this!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But then they'd come after me... Or Grandma...
Owen sits there nervously watching as the dashboard clock counts off the minutes that the guys have been inside.
`Two minutes. Three minutes. Four minutes...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Two minutes. Three minutes. Four minutes...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: They should be out already...
The `five` minute mark hits, and Owen shifts uncomfortably in the driver's seat.
nodes.text_bbcode: The [b]five[/b] minute mark hits, and Owen shifts uncomfortably in the driver's seat.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Where are they?!
`Six minutes. Seven minutes. Eight minutes...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Six minutes. Seven minutes. Eight minutes...[/b]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grr! Fine!
Owen reluctantly steps out of the idling car and heads for the warehouse door...
Inside the warehouse, Owen's eyes have trouble adjusting to the dark... He waits, noticing a laser alarm near the entrance...
He steps over it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Guys? Everything okay?
He walks farther in, heading toward what looks like a ransacked area near the back.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sal? Dom? Big Jon?
When he gets there, he doesn't find anything except an old empty box. The place is empty!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What the--?
Suddenly, the front door flies open, and Sal, Dom, and Big Jon wheel several stacks of consoles out of the warehouse!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey!
Sal looks back at Owen, smiles, and kicks his foot out, triggering the alarm!
Owen runs for the door, but Sal steps out and closes it behind him, wedges a broom into the handle, and laughs at Owen from the behind the bars!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sal! Sal! Let me out! Don't do this!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Sorry, buddy, but you're the one getting caught this time!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: I've been waiting `so` long for this moment! How's it feel to know that your life is ruined!
nodes.text_bbcode: I've been waiting [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] long for this moment! How's it feel to know that your life is ruined!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sal, don't do this, man! I never did anything to you!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: You left me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I had to... I had to get out.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Yeah, well, congratulations.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: And in case you're thinking about telling the cops, well...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Let's just say I could always go for seconds of Betty's famous spaghetti.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You won't get away with this!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: I think I will. 'Cause you're stuck in there. And I'm out here.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: I think what happens is the police come and while they won't know where those consoles went...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: They'll still hold `you` responsible.
nodes.text_bbcode: They'll still hold [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] responsible.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: They'll see that I'm stuck.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Yeah, go ahead and tell them what happened. You went on a heist and your thief friends betrayed you.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: See how much sympathy the cops have for you then...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Sucks to be you right now, doesn't it?
Sal smiles and waves goodbye. The guys stack the consoles into the trunk of Sal's car and drive off!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Stupid? Really? I'm about to make thousands of dollars in `one night.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Stupid? Really? I'm about to make thousands of dollars in [color=#e23b3b][i]one night.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Nothing stupid about that.

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Yeah, that's not stupid. That's smart.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: 'Cause money's a one-to-one measure of intelligence.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Heartless?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, we used to cause trouble when we were young...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But we'd `never` do something like this, man. The Sal I knew would `never` steal from kids!
nodes.text_bbcode: But we'd [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] do something like this, man. The Sal I knew would [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] steal from kids!

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Wait... We're stealing from kids? I thought you said we were just stealing from a charity!

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Yeah, I `like` kids!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I [color=#e23b3b][i]like[/i][/color] kids!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Shut up! All of you! Don't listen to him... He's just trying to poison your mind.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: We `are` stealing from the charity. And they'll get new consoles, and everyone'll be happy, like I said.
nodes.text_bbcode: We [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] stealing from the charity. And they'll get new consoles, and everyone'll be happy, like I said.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's bull.

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: I don't know if I want to do this...

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Me either.
Sal glares at them, his eyes threatening.

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Never mind. I'm still in.

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Me too...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: When did I become so smart? Is that what you were going to ask?

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Because that's what I'd ask someone who was about to make thousands of dollars in `one night.`

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh! I remember! They're going to a greenhouse near the sea... Something clarity! Clarity sea? No...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That doesn't sound right...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: No, it doesn't...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why don't we look at a map online? That might jog your memory...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Okay, but let's hurry!
A few minutes later, on Owen's computer...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: That's it! They're going to the toy `charity warehouse` on Industrial. Building `C!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's it! They're going to the toy [color=#3b78e2][i]charity warehouse[/i][/color] on Industrial. Building [color=#3b78e2][i]C![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I wish I'd remembered that earlier...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Anyway, I think they're up to something very indecent!
Grandma Betty dishes out spaghetti to all the guys and then sits down next to Sal. Owen watches him like a hawk.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Mmmm! Just like I remember it!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: You're looking like you're in fine health, Betty.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh, why thank you! What a thing to say! And I do drink my vegetable juice every morning, just like my doctor advises.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: So nothing's wrong? Nothing's happened to you... Yet?

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh, no, I've passed all my checkups! Still have a couple gallons of gas left in this old tank.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: You snake.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: I was just thinking... Now that I'm back, I'd really hate for something to happen to you.
He shoots a glare at Owen, hammering home the point.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We should get going.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Owie... Always trying to protect me... But who's protecting you?

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: So soon?! But the food will go to waste!

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Gotta go, Grandma.
The guys get up and head out the front door... Grandma Betty tries to pull Owen aside, but Sal intervenes...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: No time for goodbyes. Let's hit the road.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Owen...
You are now playing as Owen...
Outside, Dom and Big Jon climb into the back of Sal's slick, streamlined, black-cherry sports car. Owen can't help but whistle softly.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Tell me you're not impressed.
Sal hands Owen the keys and heads around the back of the car. He thumps his fist on the trunk, popping it open, and pulling out several black bags.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why'd you give me these keys?

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Why do you think, genius? You're the driver.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't even know where we're going.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Like that matters... Get in.
Sal gets into the car, Owen hesitates, knowing what he's about to do is dangerous...
...But then he sees Grandma Betty looking worriedly out the window.
He gets into the car.
You are now playing as Paige.
A few moments later...
...Paige returns to Owen's house!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Stupid Owen and his stupid face! Treat me like `I'm` not important! He's the one who's unimportant!
nodes.text_bbcode: Stupid Owen and his stupid face! Treat me like [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] not important! He's the one who's unimportant!

nodes.text: She grits her teeth as she marches up the walkway!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Acting all weird! What was that all about? Probably just avoiding the subject... Typical guy!
She reaches the front porch.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why should I let him get away with that?! So the timing's bad?! Is there ever a right time to discuss what's wrong with a relationship?!
Her face red, she bangs on the front door!
A moment later, it swings open!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We are having this conversation, and we are having it `n--

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Paige, dear, I'm so glad you're here!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Owie's in trouble!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? What's wrong? Where is he?

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Those hooligans took him to the, uh... the....
You are now playing as Grandma Betty.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Hold on now, give me a moment, sweetie. My memory's not what it used to be. They took him to...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I remember when I was your boys' age, I was the queen of the jitterbug!
She smiles at Sal warmly.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Now everyone simmer down and have some spaghetti!

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: See?
Sal relaxes.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I'm so confused!
Sal reaches out and grabs Betty by the arm!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Oh!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Don't play dumb with me, old lady!
Owen is up in a heartbeat!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Let her go!
But Dom and Big Jon are quick to block him!
Sal lets go of Betty's arm.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Excuse my manners. Even if you did know what we were talking about, you wouldn't say anything, would you, Grandma?

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Especially knowing that saying something could incriminate your precious grandson...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Why don't we forget about it and eat some spaghetti?

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Best idea I've heard all day.
A car slowly drives by, and Owen tenses up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You should go now.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? Why?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige, please... I can't tell you. It's for your own good.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We haven't even started to talk!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know, and I swear, I want to talk too, but now is not the time...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: In fact, now is kind of the worst time...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's going on?! Why can't you tell me?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just... Please. Go.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine! If you don't care about us, then you can just forget about having this conversation altogether!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's the opposite of what I want...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, your actions speak `way` louder than your words! I'll talk to you later!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, your actions speak [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] louder than your words! I'll talk to you later!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You know what?! Forget that! I'm never talking to you again!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige...
But Paige storms off!
You are now playing as Owen.
Owen closes the door and sighs.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If they had come just then, that would have been a disaster...
When he looks up, he sees his grandmother standing in the hallway...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: What `is` going on, Owie? You've been acting skittish all day, and I've never seen you treat your girlfriend like that before...
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] going on, Owie? You've been acting skittish all day, and I've never seen you treat your girlfriend like that before...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: You didn't even invite her in!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: One, she's not my girlfriend, and two, I'm not acting anything. Just... Please don't worry about me, Grandma.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I'll worry about you as much as I want to. That's my job!
The doorbell rings.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why is she still here?!
Owen angrily opens the door!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I told you to go, P--
But he stops when he sees who's standing on the porch...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: That's not very nice at all.

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Little pig, little pig, let us in!

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Ha! Pigs!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, I'll... I'll be right out, guys.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Sal? Is that you? And Dominick? Oh, and little Jonathan?

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: My my! Come in, all of you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, they'd come in, Grandma, but we have to--

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Hey! Let's not be rude! Besides, I didn't come all the way over here just to see your ugly mug.

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Yeah, we didn't come for ugly mugs. We came for some of Betty's Famous Spaghetti!

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Heh. I love that stuff!
They all lumber into the house. As Sal passes, he gets right in Owen's face...

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Wouldn't want to be rude to Grandma...
You are now playing as Grandma Betty.
A moment later, the four guys are all sitting at the dinner table while Grandma Betty deftly whips up some spaghetti.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I don't know what these monsters are doing here, but I've got to figure out where they're going with my Owie!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: So... Uh, boys, I haven't seen you around in ages!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: I've been detained... Not a lot of free time when you take the fall for someone...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Or break the law.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Well, I'm always telling Owie that he should choose his friends carefully...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean he shouldn't have any at all!

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Your grandma just basically called you a loser!

nodes.speaker: Big Jon
nodes.text: Ha! Loser!

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: She makes a point, `Owie.` You ditched us!
nodes.text_bbcode: She makes a point, [color=#e23b3b][i]Owie.[/i][/color] You ditched us!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I had to!

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Anyway, what are you gentlemen doing here? Are you going to a dance together?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Grandma...

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Yeah, we're going to the uh, `charity` dance.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, we're going to the uh, [color=#e23b3b][i]charity[/i][/color] dance.

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: Shut up.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: That seems important...

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: How pleasant! And where's that?

nodes.speaker: Big Jon

nodes.speaker: Sal
nodes.text: What part of shut up don't you understand?!

nodes.speaker: Dom
nodes.text: Sorry, Sal... It's not like she knows what we're talking about!
Sal looks up, inspecting Grandma Betty's face for recognition...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Glad you clarified that.

nodes.speaker: Paige

nodes.text: Lee is a total charmer! And his family owns a restaurant chain... Did you know that?

nodes.text_bbcode: Well, uh, we didn't [color=#e23b3b][i]see[/i][/color] much of the movie, if you know what I mean...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever...

nodes.text: It doesn't matter. I still... We still need to talk!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.text: We ended up doing dishes at a restaurant.

nodes.text: So, the perfect evening?

nodes.text: Haha! Rub it in more while you're at it! I'm sure you and Maria are the talk of the stupid town!

nodes.text: Actually...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

nodes.text: There's something I've never told you about me.

nodes.text: What's that?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You'll see! Just buckle up and hold onto something!

nodes.text: I've seen you drive before, Owen.

nodes.text: `Ahhhhhhhhhhh!`

nodes.text: What are you gonna do?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Paige.
Paige gets off the bus in Owen's neighborhood...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is it!
...She walks to Owen's house and stomps up the walkway...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Time to give Owen a piece of my mind!
She knocks, rapping her knuckles hard against the front door.
A moment later, the door opens a crack, and Owen peeks out. Seeing Paige, he opens it all the way.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What are you doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hi to you too!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You shouldn't be here right now! It's not safe!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't know what you're talking about, and I don't care! We need to talk!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm serious... You should go.

nodes.text: I'm serious too! I'm done with sneaking around and making out in broom closets. I need to know `what we are.`

nodes.text: What about it?

nodes.speaker: Paige

nodes.text: Evening, Betty.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Monte-Carlos.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'm terribly sorry to disturb you at such a late hour...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But your vehicle was involved in a high-speed chase on the freeway this evening!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I have reason to believe your grandson was the driver! Now, I'm going to have to place him under arrest and take him in.

nodes.text: Owie, why don't you tell Monte what happened?

nodes.text: If I hadn't, they would have hurt my grandmother.

nodes.text: Well, the law...

nodes.text: The law says that you have to put criminals behind bars... Now have you done that tonight?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am we apprehended some suspects.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Good. You've done your job. Now, I'm going to give you some spaghetti to take home and then I'm going to go to bed.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Now how does that sit with you?
Monte holds his hat in his hands, thinking...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Just fine, ma'am.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: You can come out now, children. The coast is clear.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, that was awesome!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I will never underestimate you again.

nodes.text: Nothing to it. Now, it's far too late for an old woman like me to be up. Good night, you two.
She shuffles off toward the bedroom.

nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Since when?
